narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -5.45 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.09182-0.09303 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.09353; the first objective pays 1.60R at 0.09128.

plan.triggerRule: footprint exh fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.09353 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 20/100 — trend broken, flow fading, liq magnets below
